model.description: MODEL_DIALECTIC — REQUIRED, no default: a model default in code is how a run silently measures a different model than the report claims (P5 finding)

reasoning_effort.description: Explicit reasoning effort (MEMORY_REASONING_DIALECTIC) — never inherit the provider default

description.purpose: Tier 2 of the read path: synthesises one answer across the tier-1 candidates with an explicit source priority (beliefs before facts before episodes) and a MANDATORY gap statement — what memory does not know. The gap is what separates a memory answer from a hallucination.
description.use_when: Hard questions only ('has his position on X changed, and why?'). recall routes here when memory_tier=2; tier 0 and 1 never touch it.
description.not_in_scope: No retrieval (recall has already ranked and budgeted the candidates), no store access, no writes, no tool loop — one provider call per question.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one assistant turn holding the answer JSON {answer, gap, sources, confidence}. hop.finish_reason='error' is not a crash: recall downgrades the request to the tier-1 candidate bundle and marks hop.tier_downgraded.
description.consumes_meaning: system.instructions.text: the answer contract, built by recall so prompt and parser stay in one file. messages[]: one user turn with {question, as_of, beliefs, candidates} as JSON.
examples: candidates about diet -> {"answer":"keto since january","gap":"nothing recorded after 2026-05","sources":["f1"],"confidence":80}
no candidate covers the question -> {"answer":"memory does not contain this","gap":"no episode mentions the topic at all","sources":[],"confidence":5}
